title: Quiz: What Is a Data Type?
description: Check your understanding of What Is a Data Type?.

questions.question: What is a data type?

options.text: A category that tells Python what kind of value is being used.
A folder that stores Python projects.
A function used only for printing.
A style setting in a code editor.

questions.explanation: A data type describes the kind of value Python is working with.

questions.question: Which value is most likely a string?
questions.explanation: Strings are text values written inside quotation marks.

questions.question: Why do data types matter?

options.text: They help Python decide what operations make sense.
They make code impossible to read.
They are only used in comments.
They are required only for file names.

questions.explanation: Python uses data types to understand how values should behave.
